objective: Equity book v1.2 (simple construction): preregistered after T-20261002-25 passed its mechanical rule. Test whether the T-25 R6 construction (9-theme composite M0/M1, industry-demeaned rank weights, easy-to-borrow shorts, book-level EWMA SPY beta hedge, VIX > 20.60 halving, weekly 5 tranches, fill at the close of t+1) survives an Alpaca Reg T account at $1M -- gross incl. hedge and T-bills <= 1.8x equity, whole shares and the engine minimum order, netted tranches, conservative delisting bound, borrow 0 bp on ETB per Alpaca docs, no interest on cash -- and reaches evaluation-standard v2 tier P1 under a 10-variant DSR family (111-trial program DSR disclosed, < 0.50 caps at P1), with a 100-seed placebo, so that quant1 (F1 neutral, k 0.5 plus T-bill leg) and quant2 (F2 SPY 1.0 plus a 0.3 overlay) can start paper incubation and a forward record from 2026-09-18.
target_regime_and_horizon: US equities, research-panel U3000 and P1000 members; weekly rebalancing in 5 tranches, decision at the close of D, fill at the close of D+1. Judged on the recent window 2024-01-08..2026-09-15 (the owner's recent-market rule); 2017-10..2023-08 only for the crash veto V4; 2026-07-01..09-15 only a consistency z. Target regime: the 2024-26 cross-section where industry-relative style and selection themes earn positive premia; current state up_mid (SPY above its 200-day mean, VIX 14.46-20.60); VIX > 20.60 halves the book. Validity to 2026-12-31, then a forward review; failure signals and exits in hypotheses.md section 7.
existing_solution_comparison: Professional systematic long/short equity: net Sharpe median 0.51, 90th percentile 1.18 (AQR/HFR 1996-2023). Single anomalies earn about 4 bp/month net after 2005, combinations about 20 bp (Chen-Velikov), so a multi-theme composite with cost-aware weekly trading is the standard form; the JKP themes supply the signal families. Off-the-shelf alternatives were checked on our data before allocating compute: the live anti-beta fund BTAL returned -8.9% a year in 2024-01..2026-09 (beta -0.88) and SPLV minus SPHB -18.7% a year; cap-weighted factor ETFs (SPLV, SPHB, MTUM, QUAL, VLUE, IWM vs SPY) explain 57-63% of the R6 daily variance and leave 4.8-10.9% a year unexplained (Newey-West t up to 2.1 on U3000), so buying factor ETFs does not replicate the book. Our own optimizer book (v1, RF1) lost most of the signal (transfer coefficient 0.4-0.5, T-19), which is why the simple rank-weighted construction is used. Alpaca rules (broker docs): Reg T 2x overnight with next-morning margin calls, $0 borrow on easy-to-borrow shorts, 6.50% debit interest; High-Yield Cash 3.56% APY only for non-pattern-day traders.
remaining_evidence_gap: Whether the R6 evidence survives the account layer (the k = 1 R6 book needs a long SPY hedge of 0.68-0.84x equity on average, up to 1.27x, i.e. about 3x gross, above Reg T), whole shares and the $100 minimum order at $1M, a conservative delisting bound and an honest trial count; whether it beats a within-date score-permutation placebo; and forward evidence after 2026-09-18, which no one has seen.
negative_experiments_checked: t20261001_book_v1 Stage 2a (6 variants) and RF1 negated mechanically; T-19: removing style caps adds about 0.01-0.02 Sharpe, so the loss was transfer, not caps; T-24: none of ml_pv, low MAX, near-52-week-high or the Alpha158 FDR composite adds residual IC in 2024-26 (v1.1 cancelled); Stage 0: the per-stock 252-day beta hedge left realised beta 0.5-0.9, replaced here by the book-level EWMA SPY hedge (T-25 R5/R6 realised beta <= 0.11); Q2 strength came from shorting dilutive microcaps, hence the easy-to-borrow proxy. The 263 standalone long-only anomaly directions are a different mechanism and are not reopened.
cost_and_execution_assumptions: Cost model v1 at the close snapshot through make_cost_fn("close"): half-spread, square-root impact on traded dollars at E = $1M, fees 0.5 bp per side; SPY and the T-bill ETF through the ETF branch; borrow 0 bp on easy-to-borrow shorts (Alpaca docs; 25 bp reported as sensitivity; 2x-cost check uses 2x trading costs plus 100 bp a year on all shorts); Alpaca time_in_force=cls orders before the engine cutoff (close minus 15 minutes); whole shares by round-half-away with reference prices at the close of D, orders below $100 dropped; F1: stock weights and hedge x 0.5 x VIX scale, T-bill leg filling gross to <= 1.8 without debit; F2: SPY 1.0 plus a 0.3 overlay with its hedge merged, 6.50% debit interest; positive cash earns 0 in the main estimate; delisting bound -30% longs / 0% shorts.
stop_condition: No variant reaches P1 (hypotheses.md section 6, standard v2.0.1 plus the program-DSR cap): the book line pauses until a new signal is admitted (Lazy Prices T-20261002-03/04, text layer) under a new contract; no parameter of this contract is tuned. A paper book halves or stops on the hypotheses.md section 7 rules (simulated drawdown 95th/99th percentiles, 21-session |beta| > 0.25, cost overrun, merged P(SR > 0) < 0.5).

cheapest_decisive_test.action: T-20261002-26 on the frozen research snapshot, local first: (A) reproduce the T-25 R6 daily series exactly, then the F1/F2 account layer with whole shares, the engine rules, margin checks, delisting bound and cash conventions; (B) 100-seed within-date permutation placebo through the R6 pipeline; (C) scorecard_v2 with the 10-variant DSR family, the 111-trial disclosure, robustness, vetoes and the tier per hypotheses.md.
cheapest_decisive_test.pass_condition: At least one variant reaches tier P1 under hypotheses.md section 6 with zero margin violations, and its F1 overlay keeps a recent net Sharpe within 0.25 of the strategy-level R6 (otherwise rescored on the overlay).
cheapest_decisive_test.falsification_condition: No variant reaches P1, or the account layer has margin violations that a k below 0.5 cannot remove, or the rescored overlay misses P1.
